# 87% of our portfolio companies are cross-border

As immigrant entrepreneurs ourselves, we have an intimate understanding of what it takes to establish a presence in Silicon Valley. We also know how to leverage global resources to support international expansions for US-based teams.  Cross-border company building is in our DNA.

###### Featured founder

## Everest Labs CEO, JD Ambati says, "We can speed adoption of AI solutions to eliminate losing UBCs to landfill, as this is a massive loss for the entire ecosystem.”

Designed by artificial intelligence and robotics company EverestLabs, the robot is expected to capture a little over 1 million used beverage cans (UBCs) a year. So far, the equipment is seeing up to 1,400 UBCs per day and recovering a majority of them so they go into the circular supply chain rather than going to landfill.

[Learn More](https://benhamouglobalventures.com/everestlabs-robot-funded-by-can-manufacturers-institute/)
